description: Decode Base64 (standard or URL-safe, padding optional, whitespace and data: URI prefix allowed). Valid UTF-8 text is returned inline; binary data (or anything when "output" is given) is written to a file whose extension comes from the detected type (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, BMP, PDF, ZIP, gzip, MP3, Ogg, MP4, WOFF2, SVG, JSON). Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/base64-kit/

base64.description: The Base64 text to decode (may be a data: URI).

fileName.description: Base name for the written file (extension follows the detected type). Default "decoded".

output.description: Where to write the result: a file path, or a folder ending in "/". Default: the server output folder (a temp folder unless --out-dir is set).

name: base64_decode
title: Base64 decode
